## Arena India - Events API (read-only)
Public GET endpoint that returns the Events sheet as a JSON array for the website.

**Before activating:**
1. Google Sheets node: pick your credential, your spreadsheet and the Events tab
2. Code node: put your real website address in ALLOWED_ORIGINS
3. Webhook node > Options > Allowed Origins (CORS): same addresses, comma separated
4. Toggle the workflow to Active (top right)

Production URL = Webhook node > Production URL
